notes.title: Demo Update v21a - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]We just pushed a new update to the Demo![/p][p][/p][p][b]Major[/b][/p][list][*][p]Revamped Camera controls - you can now always use keyboard/joystick to move around and only need to hold RMB to look around[/p][/*][*][p]Build Menu Camera now behaves the same as regular camera[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased build area around Castle on Skirmish Maps[/p][/*][*][p]Units will clear their bodies after 4 rounds now[/p][/*][*][p]Ranged enemies can now attack your castle by shooting arrow/fire/marbles at it[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted aiming reticles to be slightly more precise[/p][/*][*][p]Dog has slightly lower movement range now[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some enemy values like weights and attack for better balancing[b]     [/b][/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer unpossess a unit if you're jumping[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blocks no longer count towards capturing points in Skirmish[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Mug clipping the desk in background[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where hitting your own units on first turn would behave weirdly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug when unpossessing unit might not reset movement on it[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Hope you like these changes and let us know in the forums if anything feels worse :)[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v19a - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]BIG thanks to everyone posting feedback in the Steam Forums or on Our Discord! [/p][p]I've been dealing with some Life Events™ and just getting back to normal schedule. Finally had time to push a patch with a bunch of improvements![/p][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added Volume sliders directly to Main Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added Sensitivity sliders in Pause Menu (separate for looking and moving)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted first two waves on the Demo level and removed hard map edges[/p][/*][*][p]Added Wave counter on top right corner of the screen (i.e. "Wave 3 / 5" )[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted camera when controlling Archer and Mage to make aiming down easier[/p][/*][*][p]Made Houses lighter so they can't block units in as easily[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Knight attack to (hopefully) fix an issue with it behaving inconsistently[/p][/*][*][p]Added spin to Marbles when they're launched[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Knight price by 1[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Aiming Dots to behave more consistently[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements for killing enemies should now count enemies that accidentally kill themselves (otherwise it was difficult to get the last one)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed houses producing gold when knocked over[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemy units occasionally killing themselves by moving around[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy![/p][p][/p][p]- Jakub (Lead Dev)[/p]

If you plan on attending and want to say hi, come stop by our booth :)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dates:[/b] Aug 29 – Sept 1, 2025[/p][p][b]Address:[/b] Seattle Convention Center, Seattle, WA[/p][p][b]Booth[/b]: #825 in Arch Expo Hall (with big PAX Rising banner above)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45642856/eac951a6082adf949eb4f69b6ddce8ac5e55cbeb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope to see you there :)[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!!!
notes.content: [p]Knock over tabletop figurines off your kitchen table by shooting arrows and marbles! A turn-base strategy game with no health points, no stats, just physics at its best (and worst!)[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3866470/Table_Tactics_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]The demo features a single-player Tower Defense level, AS WELL AS a 2-4 player local multiplayer skirmish mode![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Single Player[/u][/b][/p][p]Defend your castle against waves of enemies! Earn coins for each enemy topped and spend them to build new defensive units. [/p][p][b][u]Point Control (PvP)[/u][/b][/p][p]Move your units inside one of the control points, and keep them safe until the next turn to earn points. The first team to reach the point limit wins the game.[/p][p][b][u]Castle Bomb (PvP)[/u][/b][/p][p]Push the heavy bomb into the enemy castle - and keep the enemy from pushig it into yours. A physical tug-of-war![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45642856/379a872ee06ca61a2b459682888521ad0e82794f.gif"][/img][/p]
